projects.name: TaskIQ: Organization-Wide Task Intelligence & Governance
projects.description: An enterprise task governance platform that gives every level of an organization one view of the work — from an executive rollup across departments down to a single assignee's inbox. Governed assignment, delegation, tiered approvals, leave coverage, and SLA monitoring run on a configuration-first engine where hierarchy, workflows, permissions, and dashboards are configured rather than coded — with full Arabic/English RTL parity.

projects.name: IMDAD: End-to-End Procurement Platform
projects.description: An end-to-end procurement platform covering the full PR → RFQ → PO → delivery lifecycle. IMDAD digitizes a complete procurement policy manual with tiered approvals, letters of credit, gate passes, product recalls, and a supplier portal — driven by a configurable workflow engine and role-based access across 38 personas.

projects.name: StoryIQ: Signal-to-Pass Approval Workflow
projects.description: A seven-stage Product Owner, engineering, and QA workflow that connects acceptance criteria, evidence, verdicts, and an application-locked Pass Record with a SHA-256 digest for tamper detection.

projects.name: SquadIQ: Delivery OS for Agile Client Teams
projects.description: A delivery OS built around pairs, not pools. Every deliverable is a card, every card has a checklist, every squad has its own kanban board, and one dashboard sees it all — so two-person squads can run client work faster and smarter.

projects.name: KAM CLI
projects.description: An open-source, single-user command layer that wraps OpenClaw with isolated local state and three configurable agents for strategy, technical implementation, and quality review.

projects.name: Wathiq: Modern E-Invoicing Platform
projects.description: An e-invoicing platform concept for structured invoice issuance, VAT-oriented validation workflows, archiving, payment visibility, and financial reporting. Regulatory configuration must be verified for each market before production use.

projects.name: IdeaIQ: Innovation Board Platform
projects.description: A collaborative brainstorming platform that helps teams capture, organize, and prioritize ideas through a structured phase-gate process — from intake to implementation.

projects.name: SprintsGate: Sprint-Driven UAT Platform
projects.description: An AI-powered UAT platform that transforms business requirements into sprint-ready test cases in minutes. SprintsGate gives agile teams a Kanban board for test execution, real-time analytics, and full requirements traceability from BRD to sign-off.

projects.name: Consultant OS: AI-Powered Consulting Workspace
projects.description: An AI-powered consulting workspace that automates documentation, meetings, reports, decisions, and workflows for modern delivery and business analysis teams.

projects.name: UX Compass: User Experience & Product Design Reference
projects.description: A comprehensive Arabic UX reference platform with 33+ frameworks, 30+ ready templates, and 12 execution playbooks — built on sources from OpenAI, IBM, NN/g, and IxDF.

projects.name: STRATA AI: Decision Intelligence Framework
projects.description: A decision intelligence system designed to support executives and PMOs in making governance-ready, high-risk decisions. Structures complex situations into clear options and produces board-ready decision outputs.

projects.name: SIHHATI: Health & Wellness Tracking Platform
projects.description: A comprehensive health and wellness tracking platform currently in beta testing. SIHHATI helps users monitor their lifestyle habits, track wellness metrics, and gain insights into their health journey.

projects.name: NuRad: AI-Powered Radiology & Medical Terminology Scanner
projects.description: A research and portfolio prototype exploring AI-assisted terminology extraction and source traceability in radiology reports; it is not clinically validated, diagnostic, or intended for patient care.

projects.name: Yadree: Business Intelligence Consultant System
projects.description: A portfolio prototype exploring AI-assisted business intelligence, SQL workflow support, data visualization, and machine-learning-assisted analysis for human decision-making.

projects.name: BoardIQ: Executive Decision Platform
projects.description: An executive decision workspace that connects PMO governance, payment intelligence, and review-led document automation for planning, vendor decisions, and board communication.

projects.name: Musajil: Enterprise Event Management Platform
projects.description: An enterprise-grade event management platform with guest-first registration, real-time operations command center, offline-tolerant check-in, and predictive analytics for seamless events.

projects.name: TAB - Revolutionizing Digital Menus for Restaurants
projects.description: A digital-menu product concept for presenting restaurant items through an interactive customer interface and exploring AI-assisted menu discovery.

projects.name: Virtue: Mental Wellness Platform
projects.description: A mental-wellness platform concept combining supportive self-guided tools with pathways to qualified practitioners. It is not presented as a diagnostic service or a replacement for professional medical care.

projects.name: KPI on the Fly AI
projects.description: An AI-assisted business intelligence concept for proposing KPIs from structured data and carrying reviewed metrics into Apache Superset dashboard workflows.

projects.name: PRF Production
projects.description: A creative-services concept exploring how AI-assisted tools can support video, photography, editing, color grading, and retouching while people retain creative direction and final review.

projects.name: SautNote AI
projects.description: An AI-assisted transcription concept that converts audio into searchable, structured notes for professionals and students, with generated text intended for user review.

projects.name: Wajibaty: AI Visual Study Graphs
projects.description: An AI study tool that turns any topic or homework question into an interactive visual graph of concepts, prerequisites, examples, and common mistakes, with node-level explanations and targeted quizzes in English or Arabic.

projects.name: SCIC (Supply Chain Intelligence Consultant) Project
projects.description: An AI supply-chain analytics concept for monitoring operations, forecasting demand, and identifying potential cost or efficiency opportunities for human review.

projects.name: Keef Libsaty: AI Fashion Recommendations
projects.description: A fashion-discovery concept exploring how image or link inputs could support visually similar product suggestions, subject to catalogue quality and human choice.
